name: token-status
description: Show Codex token usage, live rate limits, and /status-style session information in the terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex token usage and /status details in the terminal.
interface.longDescription: A utility plugin for Codex token accounting. It reads live rate limits through Codex app-server, session token_count events, and local session metadata to print a /status-style view or compact status line.
defaultPrompt: Start a live Codex token usage monitor.
